reviews.text: They prescribed medication for my rabbit, and he died four days later of a heart attack. I was supposed to have an appointment for emergency dental surgery, but the clinic wasn't in any hurry and never contacted me again. If it's an emergency, it's better to go somewhere else.

A huge thank you to the veterinarians and their teams who agreed to see my friend who found a sun conure (a parrot-like creature) and who agreed to read its leg band to find its owner. After contacting four veterinarians about this request, they were the only ones who said yes. Thank you.
Excellent veterinary teams

A team that's always responsive and attentive in every situation.
My cat is seen by Dr. Balley, a top-notch veterinarian: very attentive and professional. On several occasions, Willie has almost fallen asleep in her arms during appointments... need I say more?
You can entrust her and her team with the care of your animals without hesitation.

I take my two cats to this veterinary clinic.

We have always been warmly welcomed and well-informed.

Thank you so much for your attentiveness and professionalism 🙏🏼
Tokyo, Neo, and Leïlou
Veterinary clinic with a competent vet. The only downside is that the Bravecto increases every 3 months.

My dog ​​has been a patient at this clinic for six years now, and I can't thank them enough for saving her life so many times.
She has a chronic illness, and every time I've needed them, they've been there for me, providing gentle and compassionate care.
Thank you Drs. Balley, Alonzo, and Morlon who saw Reyka ❤️

Over a year ago, I moved near this clinic and went there somewhat by chance… and what a surprise!

There, I discovered Dr. Sandra Balley Thomas, an exceptional veterinarian, deeply compassionate and remarkably kind. From the very first appointment, you could tell she genuinely loves animals and is fully committed to their care.

But what struck me most was the day my cat developed severe edema. It was an urgent and stressful situation, and yet, despite an already busy schedule, she didn't hesitate for a second to take him in. She reacted with incredible professionalism, responsiveness, and gentleness… and she quite simply saved his life.

In those moments, you entrust someone with much more than just an animal; you entrust them with a member of your family. And knowing they are in the hands of someone so dedicated, caring, and competent is a true relief.

Thank you for everything you've done for him, and for your daily dedication.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic and especially Dr. Sandra Balley Thomas.

I have two cats who are treated by the vets at this clinic. They are very professional and gentle. The reception is impeccable.

The only downside is the parking. The parking lot is tiny; consequently, you have to find a spot in Saint-Loup, which is never easy. That's why my partner is often in the car while I go to the appointments.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Drs. Alonso and Balley and the entire team at the clinic.
My animals have been in their care for years, from Zeus and Rambo to Shanghai and now Maya.
Their professionalism, kindness, and expertise have always been exceptional.
I highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking quality care for their companions.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. They were amazing: they got me an appointment very quickly, were incredibly patient, and answered all my questions. Honestly, I'm beyond grateful; I recommend them 100%! Thank you again!!
Thank you so much, Ms. Nogaret, for this wonderful and encouraging feedback for the whole team. Give Loutcho a cuddle and see you soon!
The entire team warmly thanks you for this great review and wishes you a good day!
A huge thank you to the whole team! My little cat was cared for with such gentleness and professionalism. You can tell they are truly passionate about their work. I highly recommend them 🙏 …
Fantastic team and very attentive
Friendly welcome, I recommend it

I've been going to this clinic for 8 years now. Dr. Bailey takes care of my two dogs; she's so kind, gentle, and caring.
I highly recommend this clinic.
The receptionists are also so nice.
The staff are very attentive, I recommend this clinic!

Personally, I agree that the price is very high for the treatment.

But what shocked me was learning that a woman who brought her dog in for treatment (without, of course, knowing the exact cost) only had €140 in cash on her when it came time to pay, instead of the €180 they were asking for. The vet's reaction was to tell her to get her checkbook or bank card if she wanted to get her dog back.
It's a disgrace and shows a lack of humanity. She could have waited for the woman to bring her €40, since she had her name and address on file, given the dog's registered tattoo.
For this vet, money comes before animal care and well-being. I was shocked by this reaction, especially since it was witnesses to this scene who spoke about it.
Very good veterinary clinic, at least with my cats everything is going well and I have 3 of them.

Excellent veterinary clinic.
The staff were welcoming, competent, and attentive.
Quick and clear professional welcome
Perfect... adorable... the doctor explained my dog's problem very well... thank you so much...

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic, and especially Dr. Morlon. She is incredibly gentle, kind, and patient. I wouldn't entrust my dog ​​Doug to anyone else. Before his surgery, she took the time to reassure us, answer all our questions, and even called us afterward to give us an update. For owners as worried as we are, this kind of attention makes all the difference. Thank you so much for your professionalism and kindness. Doug says thank you too 🐾💛

I highly recommend the Saint-Loup Veterinary Clinic.
My dog ​​has been a patient there since he was a baby; they are always available and attentive.
The team is very honest about their prices, never overcharging, and always prioritizes the animal's well-being above all else.
It's rare to find such a professional and caring practice. I recommend them without hesitation!
The entire team thanks you warmly for your feedback and looks forward to seeing you again soon. Have a wonderful summer!
Excellent care for the animals, the staff are very friendly.

I am extremely grateful to have this clinic close to home, with a competent and caring team that is always attentive and very responsive. I highly recommend this clinic and thank the superb team a thousand times over!

A veterinary team like few I've ever encountered, with empathy beyond compare, and truly compassionate support from beginning to end.
Thank you for Kinai, thank you for giving us the opportunity to cherish every moment with him and for listening to us. Thank you from our entire family.
I go every year to get my dog ​​vaccinated 🐕 cool and nice …

I absolutely do not recommend this vet; the quality of their services is only getting worse. They let my dog ​​die due to lack of proper care.

I called at 9:00 AM because my dog ​​was having trouble breathing (he has a history of heart problems, which they are very familiar with since he is being treated there). They gave me an appointment more than an hour later. I insisted, reminding them that he has heart failure. They told me to bring him in, that they would keep him for observation within 10 minutes. I wasn't even there yet, and I was left waiting in the waiting room with my suffering dog for almost an hour. They finally took him in. They called me at noon to tell me to come pick him up, but by the time I arrived, it was too long for them because they had to close. Besides, I don't live nearby, so they finally told me to come pick him up at 3:00 PM. Having to go back to work, my father went to pick him up, and on the way home, he started bleeding from his nose and mouth, stopped breathing, and died in his arms. My father ran back to the vet, they took him in, and then came back to tell him he was dead. They give us choices about what to do with his body without any compassion! It's a disgrace! And the pain we felt!
I'm only giving one star because I can't give zero, but believe me, run from this clinic. They're only interested in money. Aside from minor injuries and vaccinations, and even then, I'm not sure they're competent enough!
Small parking lot, always someone to answer the phone, attentive professionals.
Top-notch clinic, efficiency and kindness. Nina, my beloved cat, sends a big thank you to Dr. Morlon who professionally and gently nursed her back to health.

Avoid at all costs! I brought my cat in for an ear scratch, and she told me it was an allergy. I brought him back every month, sometimes even twice a month, but never a blood test, nothing, no examination whatsoever, just a change of food. I switched vets and I recommend the St. Bernabé clinic. They're fantastic! My cat lost teeth that St. Loup didn't even notice. So today, I had a blood test, a tooth removed, and Dr. Colon at the St. Bernabé clinic said it's either his liver or kidneys. I blame the St. Loup clinic for doing nothing. I'm losing my cat because of their incompetence. I picked up my cat yesterday afternoon, and Dr. Colon confirmed that the teeth fell out at least six months ago. I've had several visits to your clinic, so don't tell me his general condition was fine. Since I can't give another opinion, I'm taking the liberty of telling you that I called to tell you about my cat. He had really lost weight, you told me to give him gourmet food mixed with kibble, you didn't even offer to see him again, I also want to point out that during the palpation, Dr. Colon saw a lump, so he took an x-ray and had follow-up appointments, he only had one visit to discover the teeth and the lump, and you?

Last night, we had to take our White Swiss Shepherd, Sangha, to this veterinary clinic for an emergency appointment, and we are incredibly grateful. Worried about his deteriorating condition—swelling under his eye, jaw pain that worsened throughout the day, and crying when he yawned or when the area was touched—we contacted the clinic on our way home from work. Despite the late hour and the fact that we weren't yet clients (being new to the area), they immediately scheduled an appointment for us, squeezing us in between other patients.

The veterinarian was gentle and attentive, taking the time to carefully examine Sangha and quickly make a diagnosis. She explained the cause of the problem in detail, her reasoning, and the treatment plan. We were given a clear prescription and a follow-up appointment scheduled for a week later to monitor Sangha's progress.

The reception was equally outstanding. Having visited several veterinary clinics, I can say that this one stands out for its professionalism and kindness. I highly recommend it! Thank you again to the whole team!
Thank you for the emergency rescue of our Pumba after he was playing with caterpillars.

I'm really disappointed this time. You pay €600 for them to treat your cat, but there are no positive results. You go back to see the doctor, and she tells you you have to pay another €600 for hospitalization. Or you take your cat home. Honestly, there's no humanity in them; they only talk about money. It's a business, and for me, it's a disaster. You see an animal suffering, and you do nothing. Thank goodness there are humane veterinarians out there.
Top-notch clinic! I switched clinics to this one and have absolutely no regrets. The caregivers are incredibly kind.

For several years now I have placed my complete trust in Mrs. Alonzo and her entire team; the veterinarians are all highly professional and the reception from the assistants is wonderful and very kind; thank you all again.

A veterinary practice that lives up to the expectations of any pet owner who loves their animal.

Attentive listening, compassionate care, and a human touch throughout.

We sincerely thank Dr. Alonso, his veterinary assistants, and the entire team. They were all wonderful in supporting us through the passing of our beloved pet.

Thank you for all these years of care and your support in his final moments before his departure.

14 years of advice and attention for our Cocker Spaniel.

Excellent veterinary clinic. Our beloved dog Gabin was cared for there throughout his 13 years of life, and it's also where he passed away on December 19th. I would like to thank Dr. Balley, who was with us all these years. She was an excellent veterinarian, very compassionate, and always offered sound advice, as well as the entire team of veterinary assistants, who were very welcoming, efficient, and kind.

The prices are very reasonable, not at all a money grab as some reviews suggest; on the contrary, they are very accommodating. Thank you again to the whole team.

Maya and Dr. Alonzo were always very well received. He is incredibly kind and offers excellent advice, and can even schedule a quick appointment if needed. Of course, the cost might be difficult to manage on a low income, but when you love your pet, it's not a big deal. I highly recommend him!

The vets just saved my cat Willy, who was hit by a car. They did a fantastic job (fractured jaw, very serious facial infection). I highly recommend this clinic. They are all incredibly professional, from the receptionist to the assistants and the doctors. My Willy has come a long way. They took care of him as if he were their own. I am so grateful that they were able to save him. My daughter was able to get her cat back. We were very scared. Willy is thrilled to be home with his family and quickly regained his appetite. Thank you again to the whole team.

It's shameful that you let my dog ​​leave your clinic like that, and when my partner brought her back, you didn't even question your actions, even though your work is a complete butchery! You didn't even put a cone on her to prevent infection from licking herself... how is it possible that you're allowed to practice? It's disgraceful. Luckily, colleagues from another clinic were able to take care of her like true professionals.

My cats Gibs and Abby have been under Dr. Bailey's care for years! Thanks to her and her team, Abby narrowly escaped a tragic end a year ago due to a severe kidney infection! She was hospitalized for a week, during which they let us have a room for almost an hour every day so we could visit her! When you love someone, you don't count the cost, and they are very accommodating financially! And now my little Abby is in perfect health! When I took her for her annual checkup, she wasn't traumatized at all, which proves they are attentive and take good care of our animals. I recommend them 200%!

This veterinary clinic is a disaster! They don't care about animals and only care about money. They offered emergency surgery, claiming it was vital, for over €400. Take your dog to another vet for a simple bandage; no surgery and no life-threatening danger. A vet is supposed to love animals, which means nothing to them because they're much more interested in money. Goodbye, and I hope others will do the same.
